A forecast of the number and skills of staff needed, compared with those available, showing how any gap will be closed.
Labour turnover (%) = leavers in the year ÷ average number of employees × 100.
Recruits needed = forecast need − (staff now − expected leavers). Leavers must be replaced too.
Higher recruitment and training costs, lost experience, lower morale and quality; may signal low pay or poor management.

Reducing the workforce by not replacing employees who leave, avoiding redundancy.
